title: Prevent WebSocket Subscription Loss on Hub Restart and False Stale-Tick Pruning

tasks.title: Preserve subscriptions and callbacks across MarketFeedHub restart!
tasks.description: Snapshot subscribed keys and callbacks before stop! inside MarketFeedHub#restart! and restore them when start! succeeds without changing direct stop! behavior

tasks.title: Reconcile ChainWatchService subscriptions with MarketFeedHub state
tasks.description: Include legs missing from a running MarketFeedHub in Options::ChainWatchService#resubscribe_legs! even when present in @subscribed_legs

tasks.title: Check cached_at before ts in RedisTickCache#prune_stale
tasks.description: Use cached_at packet arrival timestamp with fallback to ts when evaluating tick staleness in Live::RedisTickCache#prune_stale

edges.reason: ChainWatchService self-healing complements MarketFeedHub restart preservation
Pruning fix follows subscription persistence fixes
